trans-unit.target: TEXT_REGFIM7V6E2CREWC_00991_SALVAGECREWC_000_000<tab>While we rarely encounter survivors, we're always prepared for the occasion. You don't have to worry about food and shelter.
TEXT_REGFIM7V6E2CREWC_00991_SALVAGECREWC_000_100<tab>The isle's thawed enough that I could pitch a tent for you and your companions. It isn't much, but it should be comfortable enough.

TEXT_REGFIM7V6E2CREWC_00991_SALVAGECREWC_000_101<tab>If I may ask...what does Estinien do for a living? When not on watch, he's constantly training, and often without any upper garments despite the cold...
TEXT_REGFIM7V6E2CREWC_00991_SALVAGECREWC_000_200<tab>We're not far now! While the journey's taken longer than expected, having you all for company made it go by faster.
TEXT_REGFIM7V6E2CREWC_00991_SALVAGECREWC_000_201<tab>The isle has thawed up nicely as well. We should be able to hand it off as soon as we arrive.
